name: Curitibanos (Brazil)
description: White field with sixteen red stripes radiating in pairs from a central white rectangle edged in red, which bears the municipal arms.
history: Curitibanos is a municipality in the state of Santa Catarina, Brazil. Portuguese Wikipedia records that the flag was created by Law No. 755 of 14 August 1968: the sixteen red stripes symbolise municipal power and the central rectangle with the arms the seat of the municipality. Flags of the World notes several variants, with or without a border around the rectangle, and that Law No. 5,622 of 2015 also made the Contestado flag a symbol of the municipality.
